sloka: गौतमेन एवम् उक्तस्य स रोषेण महात्मना ।पेततुः वृषणौ भूमौ सहस्राक्षस्य तत् क्षणात् ॥१-४८-२९॥
transliteration: gautamena evam uktasya sa roṣeṇa mahātmanā ।petatuḥ vṛṣaṇau bhūmau sahasrākṣasya tat kṣaṇāt ॥1-48-29॥

translations.english: Having thus cursed Indra, he also cursed Ahalya: 'You will be staying here for thousands of years without food and subsisting on air, lying down in ashes, doing penance, without being seen by any living beings in this ashrama'.
